Subject: Coord: Full-loop panel microblocks, scribe assign & last-minute backfills

Hi all,

We have Maya Chen's full virtual loop next Wednesday (6/19). Candidate is on PT and prefers mornings (PDT). Given panel size (4 interviews across two slots) I sketched a microblock rotation to keep each interviewer contiguous and to minimize token handoff latency in debriefs. See attached: panel-rotation-proposal.csv and maya-chen-brief.pdf.

Quick asks:
- Laura / Jonas: can one of you be the primary scribe for the 2nd slot debrief? We want a single scribe to capture rubric highlights to avoid duplicate notes.
- Priyom: please confirm the backup evaluator pool (2 people) in case of last-minute drop.
- If anyone needs a slot reorder for timezone reasons, flag it today — I'll finalize invites by EOD.

Candidate prep: I'll send a short preflight email to Maya with 'what to expect' script (candidate-prep-script.txt attached) after we lock the schedule.

Attachments: maya-chen-brief.pdf (candidate resume + portfolio), panel-rotation-proposal.csv, candidate-prep-script.txt

Thanks,

Neha — thanks for the plan and attachments. Quick notes:

- I can scribe the second slot debrief but prefer to be 10 minutes earlier in the slot (slot 2 starts 11:30 PDT, can we move it to 11:20?) — gives me a buffer for the handoff from slot 1.
- I see Maya has a 2pm meeting block on her calendar (from her recruiter's note) — if we compress the loop too tightly we risk overlap.

If moving slot 2 by ten minutes works for Jonas/others I'm good to take scribe. Otherwise I can be backup and Jonas can take primary.

Subject: Final schedule & candidate preflight — Full virtual onsite (6/19)

Hi Maya — nice to meet you (virtually)!

Thanks for coordinating with Acme. We've finalized the schedule for your virtual onsite on Wednesday, 6/19. Highlights:

- Start: 9:00 AM PDT
- Slot 1: 9:00–10:10 AM PDT (two interviews + 5-minute buffer)
- Break: 10:10–10:25 AM PDT
- Slot 2: 11:20–12:30 PM PDT (two interviews + debrief) — Laura will be the primary scribe for the slot 2 debrief.

Please find attachments with a short prep script and the candidate brief. We will send calendar invites with links shortly. If anything in the schedule conflicts with your day, please reply to this email and Acme Talent Ops will loop back.

What to expect (short): arrive on the call 5 minutes early, keep your camera on for introductions, and we will save 10 minutes at the end for questions.

Attachments: candidate-prep-script.txt, maya-chen-brief.pdf
